_comment: WO-F09-04. Every route in stormwood_world.json is painted into the Stormwood Terrain3D control map by scripts/world/build_stormwood_terrain.gd, as the named terrain_playground.json texture slot, with blend 0 and the auto-shader bit cleared (a partial control blend does not draw on this build; see build_playground_terrain.gd). grass_field.gd reads the same control map: its grass refuses that slot and its stone tier fills it. A texel is painted when its distance to the nearest route segment is within the lane half-width for the route's kind, plus the spur junction flare, plus the coherent edge wander, plus a per-texel fringe. Moving a route or changing this file stales the terrain bake manifest.

lane_half_width_m._comment: Metres either side of the route centreline. The trainer is 1.80 m. Spurs are narrower than any road but still read as a path; every route kind in stormwood_world.json must have a width here or the bake fails.

edge._comment: wander_m moves the edge in and out along the road on coherent noise with wander_wavelength_m, so the lane is not a ruled ribbon; fringe_m is a per-texel random band across the edge. half-width - wander_m - fringe_m/2 must stay above 1.25 m so every centreline point keeps a painted texel within reach on the 2 m lattice.

junction._comment: Where a spur leaves its road the spur widens by flare_m on each side at the junction, easing back to its lane width over flare_length_m up the spur, so the Y reads on the ground.
